title: Measure how slow a long valley is
brief: Compute the condition number, measure the shrink ratio of a walk, and count the steps to reach a tolerance on round and stretched bowls.
hints: condition_number is L / mu, and eigenvalue_range(A) already returns (mu, L).
contraction_ratios: errors = np.linalg.norm(path - w_star, axis=1), then errors[1:] / errors[:-1].
steps_to_tolerance: np.nonzero(errors < tol * errors[0])[0]. Return the first index, or -1 when the array is empty.
